subject: Deploy Prison Escape real gang names — prepared patch and blockers
body:

In /Users/elifoltyn/Downloads/gta6, I changed src/systems/prisoncars.js labels and spoken phrases: White car → Aryan Brotherhood; Black car → Black Guerrilla Family; Southsiders → Sureños; Paisas → Border Brothers; Asian car → Asian Boyz; Others → Independents. src/systems/interact.js now labels inmates without active gang membership Independent. Internal IDs and heritage-based yard assignments remain.

Validation: prison-cars-check passed 77/77; interact-verbs-check passed 145 contexts; syntax checks passed. I added gang-white/gang-black scenes to tools/visual-presets/interaction-prison.mjs, but visual capture could not start its local server. No visual verification of the new names, no source commit, and no deployment.

Prepared a narrow patch against the existing gh-pages release, changing only the two runtime files and release-manifest.json. Files are in artifacts/prison-names-deploy/release/: publication.json contains the Git tree entries; receipt.json records checks and blockers; the two patched scripts and manifest are also there. Base deployment commit: 791ead127b613d9d3deb5454b872a83858995b11; base tree: dae4995212f0c6a13df0bd9ea99608616511a819. Expected patched manifest SHA256: ac30aacaa854e00b20408bbd51654923d861124ed433f78e22b1f91b859f56c0. tools/prepare-prison-names-release.mjs generated this from manifest-verified deployed bytes; baseline.json is in the parent artifact directory.

My shell could not resolve GitHub, and GitHub connector create_tree rejected the write because approval is required but unavailable. No remote mutation occurred.

Please inspect the diff, verify the remote head has not changed, publish through your authorized deployment path, and verify Pages serves the updated manifest and gang labels at https://efoltyn.github.io/gta6/prison-escape.html. Rebase/regenerate the patch if the remote advanced; do not force-push or publish unrelated checkout work. Read /Users/elifoltyn/harness/AGENTS.md and .harness.env; finish with a deployment receipt and visual evidence if available. The release directory is a partial update, not a complete site package.

Exploration notes are in artifacts/prison-interaction-exploration-20260930.md and artifacts/prison-gang-names-20260930.md. Broader interaction improvements were proposed only. The user explicitly chose real names after discussing uncertainty about legal clearance and gang reactions; neither was guaranteed.
